mapper.select: SELECT id,phone,login_time loginTime,vip,register_time regTime,account_now accountNow,code_total codeTotal,code_now codeNow,login_ip loginIp,register_type registerType,remark from member_info where id = #{userid}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(recharge_money),0) rechargemoney from member_recharge_bank where status = '3' and member_id = #{userid}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(real_money),0) submoney from member_recharge_online where status='1' and member_id = #{userid} and pay_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(income),0) rgIncome FROM log_money${tableLast} where type = '110' and user_id = #{userId}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(income),0) zsIncome FROM log_money${tableLast} where type in ('102','104','106','108') and user_id = #{userId}
select COUNT(1) wCount from member_withdraw_detail where status in ('3','6') and withdraw_id = #{userid}
select IFNULL(SUM(withdraw_money),0) wSum from member_withdraw_detail where STATUS in ('0','1','3','4','6') and withdraw_id = #{userid}

(select count(1) gcount FROM member_game_data${tableLast} WHERE agent in ('10000','80000') and (cell_score - profit)/cell_score > 1 and 1.04 > (cell_score - profit)/cell_score and account = #{userid})
select count(1) gtcount FROM member_game_data${tableLast} WHERE agent in ('10000','80000') and account = #{userid}

select p.name as class_twoname,convert(sum(g.cell_score),decimal(10,2)) touZhu,convert(sum(g.profit),decimal(10,2)) yingLi FROM member_game_data${tableLast} g LEFT JOIN game_platform p on g.platform_id = p.id WHERE account = #{userid} GROUP BY g.platform_id
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(recharge_money),0) usdtrechargemoney from member_recharge_usdt where status = '3' and member_id = #{userid}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(withdraw_money),0) FROM member_withdraw_detail where withdraw_id = #{memberId} and status in (3,6)
